name: gmail
label: Gmail
description: Gmail as a mail provider for the Inbox — sync and flag write-through, installed at runtime.
author: TheBananaStand

sends.purpose: Your Google account token, and the read/starred/archived/trashed changes you make in the Inbox so they land in Gmail too. Mail travels one way — Google's servers to your hub — and nothing from Leo's other packages is attached. The token is minted by Leo per call from the Google account you already connected; this package holds no OAuth app of its own.
